rationale: The papers 'A Fast, Parallelized, GPU-Accelerated Photochemical Model, XODIAC' (2512.06729) and 'Thin H$_2$-dominated Atmospheres as Signposts of Magmatic Outgassing' (2510.07378) contribute new evidence on the theoretical and numerical approaches required to interpret atmospheric observations, particularly in the context of outgassing chemistry.
